title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Duo #01 (세로 띠 4구역·매끈 / 가로 띠 4구역·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a poised, refined, confident expression, sultry, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in low bun, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 22% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 56% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 76% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions), wide gold-and-crimson bands following the contours of the body, with jewel-toned scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a serene expression, cool and composed, sleek silver-grey hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 21% of the way down her figure from the top, about 42% of the way down her figure from the top and about 72% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), wide mother-of-pearl bands following the contours of the body, with dense scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: platform stiletto slingbacks, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
